paper_title: MMRA A Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Granularity and Multi-Image   Relational Association Capabilities in Large Visual Language Models
caption: The number and ratio of each subtask in our MMRA benchmark. The integers in the graph represent the number of samples in each task, while the percentages in parentheses indicate the proportion of each task in the entire benchmark.
model_annotation: This pie chart represents the distribution of subtasks within the MMRA benchmark. There are eleven slices, each representing a different subtask: “NearSameEntity” (63, 6.34%), “ObservationAngle” (126, 12.28%), “RelativePosition” (81, 7.90%), “SimilarMaterial” (106, 10.33%), “MentalitySimilarity” (89, 8.67%), “SubEvent” (100, 9.74%), “SimilarEvent” (90, 8.77%), “UsageSimilarity” (100, 9.65%), “AppearanceSimilarity” (90, 8.77%), “Layout” (90, 8.77%), and “Environment” (90, 8.77%). The chart includes percentage labels displayed inside each slice, and the segments appear ordered from smallest to largest in terms of their relative size. A legend is not explicitly included.
